Sandbox_Bicycle_SpawnRate_tooltip: Percent-based multiplier applied to bicycle spawn chances. Set to 0 to disable bicycle spawns entirely.
Sandbox_Bicycle_WalkSpeedMultiplier_tool: Set your player speed when riding the bicycle and not holding SHIFT.
Sandbox_Bicycle_RunSpeedMultiplier_toolt: Set your player speed when riding the bicycle and holding SHIFT.
Sandbox_Bicycle_ImmersiveMode_tooltip: When enabled you will be slower on rough surfaces unless the bicycle has a full offroad wheel setup.
Sandbox_Bicycle_AllowTransferToInventory: Allow bicycles to be transferred into the player inventory instead of only the floor or vehicle trunk.
